---

### ⚡ أبرز مميزات الأدوات والأقسام (Main Features)

#### 🎯 1. قسم الاستهداف الذكي (Target System)
* **رصد واستهداف دقيق:** تتبع أي لاعب داخل السيرفر عن طريق الاسم أو جزء منه.
* **بطاقة معلومات ملونة:** عرض صورة أفتار الضحية (HeadShot بحجم 85x85) مع حالة الاتصال (متصل / خرج من السيرفر).
* **مؤقت بانق العدو:** حاسبة زمنية دقيقة لقياس مدة البانق والاستهداف بالثواني والدقائق.
* **أنماط البانق الخمسة (Bang Modes):**
  * 🔥 **بانق أمامي:** تثبيت وحركة أمامية متناسقة.
  * ⚡ **بانق Laser السريع:** دوران واستهداف حركي مشتت للعدو.

  * 🌀 **بانق التشقلب الاحترافي:** حركة دائرية ثلاثية الأبعاد.
  * ✨ **بانق الدوران الهجومي:** دوران لولبي محيط بالهدف.

#### 🛡️ 2. قسم Anti-AFK (نظام الصملة)
* **حماية مطلق من الخمول:** يمنع طردك من اللعبة مهما طالت فترة غيابك عن الشاشة.
* **تجديد تلقائي ناعم:** نط ومشي خفيف تلقائي كل 500 ثانية لإبقاء اتصالك نشطاً بدون إزعاج.
* **عداد تنازلي مباشر:** لمعرفة الوقت المتبقي للتحديث القادم.

#### 📊 3. قسم سجل صملاتي (PlayTime & Victims Tracker)
* **سجل وقت صملتك الخاص:** يحسب مدة بقائك داخل السيرفر بالأيام، الساعات، الدقائق، والثواني.

  * تتبع حتى **20 ضحية** مختلفة بأسماء وأفتارات رسمية.
  * حساب عدد مرات دخول وخرج كل ضحية للعبة.

#### ⚡ 4. قسم الـ FPS وتخفيف اللاج (FPS & Ultra Performance)
* **عداد الـ FPS والـ Ping:** قياس مباشر وسريع لأداء اللعبة واستجابة السيرفر.
* **Master Tools:** إلغاء الظلال وتحسين الإضاءة لتسريع الاستجابة.
* **FPS Boost (النقي):** إخفاء الأجسام البعيدة عن 90 متر لرفع الفريمات بدون تقطيع أثناء المشي مع إمكانية إرجاع العالم كما كان عند الإيقاف.
* **🚀 Ultra Cleaner:** إيقاف التأثيرات البصرية والجسيمات مع تنظيف دوري للذاكرة لمنع هبوط الفريمات.

#### 🛡️ 5. قسم المضادات الشاملة (Protections)
حزم حماية متكاملة لمنع الثغرات والتلاعب بشخصيتك:

---

* **دعم كامل للمس والسحب:** تصميم يتيح لك تحريك اللوحة وسحبها بحرية من الجوانب والمساحات الفارغة بدون التعارض مع الأزرار.

local function updateTargetSearch()
    local textVal = bx.Text:gsub("%s+", "")
    local query = textVal:lower()
    
    if query == "" then
        lockedPlayer = nil
        lockedUserId = nil
        lockedPlayerName = ""
        wasEverInServer = false
        av.Visible = false
        av.Image = ""
        nm.Text = ""
        st.Text = "الحالة: بانتظار أدخال الهدف..."
        st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        br = false 
        bt = 0 
        bl.Text = FBT(bt)
        return
    end

    local foundPlr = nil
    for _, pl in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if pl ~= LP then
            local pName = pl.Name:lower()
            local pDisp = pl.DisplayName:lower()
            if pName == query or pDisp == query or pName:sub(1, #query) == query or pDisp:sub(1, #query) == query then
                foundPlr = pl
                break
            end
        end
    end
    
    if foundPlr then
        local isNewConnection = (lockedPlayer ~= foundPlr)
        lockedPlayer = foundPlr
        lockedUserId = foundPlr.UserId
        lockedPlayerName = foundPlr.Name
        wasEverInServer = true
        
        if isNewConnection then
            bt = 0
        end
        
        pcall(function()
            local th = P:GetUserThumbnailAsync(lockedUserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
            av.Image = th 
            av.Visible = true 
        end)
        nm.Text = lockedPlayerName
        st.Text = "🟢 اللاعب متصل…"
        st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
    else
        if wasEverInServer and lockedPlayerName ~= "" then
            lockedPlayer = nil
            st.Text = "🔴 خرج اللاعب"
            st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
            br = false
        else
            lockedPlayer = nil
            lockedUserId = nil
            wasEverInServer = false
            av.Visible = false
            av.Image = ""
            nm.Text = ""
            st.Text = "🟡 لا يوجد لاعب بهذا الاسم"
            st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
            br = false
        end
    end
end

local isPhysicsCustomized = false
local function resetPhysics()
    if not isPhysicsCustomized then return end
    pcall(function()
        local my = LP.Character
        if my then
            local hum = my:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then 
                hum.PlatformStand = false
                hum.Sit = false 
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
            end
            local hrp = my:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end
    end)
    isPhysicsCustomized = false
end

R.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not bng1Active and not bng2Active and not bngBackActive and not bngSpinActive and not bngMagicActive then
        br = false
        if isPhysicsCustomized then
            resetPhysics()
        end
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        if not lockedPlayer or lockedPlayer.Parent ~= P then
            br = false
            resetPhysics()
            return
        end

        if not lockedPlayer.Character or not lockedPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            br = false
            resetPhysics()
            return 
        end

        local myChar = LP.Character
        if not myChar or not myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then 
            resetPhysics()
            return 
        end
        
        local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local t = myChar.HumanoidRootPart
        local tt = lockedPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart

        isPhysicsCustomized = true
        if hum then 
            hum.PlatformStand = true 
            hum.Sit = false
        end

        t.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        t.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        local timeTick = tick()
        st.Text = "🟢 اللاعب متصل…"
        st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
        br = true

        local smoothTilt = math.sin(timeTick * 30) * 0.8
        local smoothFront = math.sin(timeTick * 32) * 2.2
        local smoothSide = math.sin(timeTick * 28) * 2.4

        if bngMagicActive then
            ag += 0.5
            t.CFrame = tt.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, -1.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, ag, 0)
        elseif bngSpinActive then
            ag += 0.8
            t.CFrame = tt.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(ag, ag, 0)
        elseif bngBackActive then
            t.CFrame = tt.CFrame * CFrame.new(smoothSide, 1.4, 2.0 + smoothFront) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, smoothTilt)
        elseif bng2Active then
            ag += 12.0
            t.CFrame = tt.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(ag, ag, 0)
        elseif bng1Active then
            t.CFrame = tt.CFrame * CFrame.new(smoothSide, 1.4, -1.0 + smoothFront) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), smoothTilt)
        end
    end)
end)

    local query = victimInput.Text:lower():gsub("%s+", "")

    if #victimsList >= 20 then return end
    
    local foundP = nil
    for _, pl in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if pl ~= LP and (pl.Name:lower() == query or pl.DisplayName:lower() == query or pl.Name:lower():sub(1, #query) == query) then
            foundP = pl
            break
        end
    end
    
    local targetName = foundP and foundP.Name or victimInput.Text
    local targetUserId = foundP and foundP.UserId or 0
    
    if targetUserId == 0 then
        pcall(function()
            targetUserId = P:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(targetName)
        end)
    end
    
    for _, existing in ipairs(victimsList) do
        if existing.Name:lower() == targetName:lower() then
            victimInput.Text = ""
            return
        end
    end
    
    local th = ""
    if targetUserId > 0 then
        pcall(function()
            th = P:GetUserThumbnailAsync(targetUserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
        end)
    end
    
    table.insert(victimsList, {
        Name = targetName,
        Thumb = th,
        PlaySeconds = 0,
        JoinCount = 0,
        ExitCount = 0,
        IsPresent = (foundP ~= nil)
    })
    victimInput.Text = ""
    renderVictims()
end)

scripts.script:
-- [[ MINECRAFT FONT CHANGER - SAFE VERSION ]] --
-- Ganti font jadi Minecraft tanpa bikin layout berantakan

if _G.MinecraftSafe then pcall(function() _G.MinecraftSafe:Stop() end) end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

-- ============================================================================
-- CONFIG
-- ============================================================================
local MC_FONT = Enum.Font.Arcade

-- Daftar nama GUI yang DI-SKIP (biar gak berantakan)
local SKIP_NAMES = {
    ["Chat"] = true,
    ["RobloxChat"] = true,
    ["TopBarApp"] = true,
    ["SettingsMenu"] = true,
    ["RobloxGui"] = true,
}

-- Scan delay (makin gede, makin ringan)
local SCAN_DELAY = 1

-- ============================================================================
-- STATE
-- ============================================================================
local running = true
local changedCount = 0
local changedList = {}

-- ============================================================================
-- CEK APAKAH OBJECT HARUS DI-SKIP
-- ============================================================================
local function shouldSkip(obj)
    local current = obj
    local depth = 0
    while current and depth < 5 do
        if SKIP_NAMES[current.Name] then
            return true
        end
        current = current.Parent
        depth = depth + 1
    end
    return false
end

-- ============================================================================
-- GANTI FONT (TANPA UBAH SIZE)
-- ============================================================================
local function changeFont(obj)
    if not obj or not obj.Parent then return end

    -- Cek apakah ini text object
    local isTextObj = false
    pcall(function()
        isTextObj = obj:IsA("TextLabel") 
            or obj:IsA("TextButton") 
            or obj:IsA("TextBox")
    end)

    if not isTextObj then return end

    -- Skip kalo di daftar skip
    if shouldSkip(obj) then return end

    -- Skip kalo udah pake font Minecraft
    pcall(function()
        if obj.Font == MC_FONT then return end

        -- Simpen original font (buat restore)
        if not obj:GetAttribute("OriginalFont") then
            obj:SetAttribute("OriginalFont", obj.Font.Name)
        end

        -- GANTI FONT DOANG — JANGAN UBAH SIZE/LAYOUT
        obj.Font = MC_FONT
        changedCount = changedCount + 1
        table.insert(changedList, obj)
    end)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- SCAN SEMUA GUI
-- ============================================================================
local function scanAll()
    -- 1. PlayerGui (GUI game)
    pcall(function()
        local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if pg then
            for _, obj in pairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
                changeFont(obj)
            end
        end
    end)

    -- 2. Workspace (BillboardGui / nametag)
    pcall(function()
        for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BillboardGui") or obj:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                for _, child in pairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                    changeFont(child)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- LOOP SCAN
-- ============================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    while running do
        scanAll()
        task.wait(SCAN_DELAY)
    end
end)

-- ============================================================================
-- FUNGSI RESTORE (balikin ke font asli)
-- ============================================================================
local function restoreAll()
    for _, obj in pairs(changedList) do
        pcall(function()
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                local origName = obj:GetAttribute("OriginalFont")
                if origName then
                    -- Balikin font asli
                    for _, font in pairs(Enum.Font:GetEnumItems()) do
                        if font.Name == origName then
                            obj.Font = font
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    obj:SetAttribute("OriginalFont", nil)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    changedList = {}
    changedCount = 0
end

-- ============================================================================
-- API
-- ============================================================================
_G.MinecraftSafe = {
    Stop = function()
        running = false
        print("⛏ Minecraft Font stopped.")
    end,
    Restore = function()
        restoreAll()
        print("⛏ Semua font dibalikin ke aslinya.")
    end,
    Status = function()
        return running, changedCount
    end,
    SkipGUI = function(name)
        SKIP_NAMES[name] = true
        print("⛏ Skip GUI: " .. name)
    end,
}

print("⛏ MINECRAFT FONT - SAFE VERSION LOADED!")
print("📌 Font diganti tanpa ubah size/layout")
print("📌 Kalo ada GUI berantakan, ketik: _G.MinecraftSafe.SkipGUI('NamaGUI')")
print("📌 Buat balikin: _G.MinecraftSafe.Restore()")
print("📌 Buat matiin: _G.MinecraftSafe.Stop()")

local function draggable(frame,handle)  
	local dragging = false  
	local dragStart  
	local startPos  
  
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)  
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then  
  
			dragging = true  
			dragStart = input.Position  
			startPos = frame.Position  
  
			input.Changed:Connect(function()  
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then  
					dragging = false  
				end  
			end)  
		end  
	end)  
  
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)  
		if dragging and (  
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch  
		) then  
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart  
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(  
				startPos.X.Scale,  
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,  
				startPos.Y.Scale,  
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y  
			)  
		end  
	end)  
end

scripts.script:
local M = {
    version = "5.2", dead = false, generation = 0, mining = false, scanning = false, deepScanning = false,
    connections = {}, rows = {}, workers = {}, entries = {}, catalog = {}, observed = {},
    categories = {}, logs = {}, filter = "All tools", category = "", query = "",
    page = 1, pageSize = 36, selected = nil, busy = nil, nextRequest = 0,
    source = "Not mined", coverage = "Not mined", rawConfig = nil, remoteTree = nil, deepStats = {},
    handoffDonorName = nil, lastIncomingOffer = nil,
    colors = {
        bg = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 28), panel = Color3.fromRGB(26, 32, 40),
        row = Color3.fromRGB(33, 41, 51), active = Color3.fromRGB(44, 72, 91),
        text = Color3.fromRGB(232, 241, 248), muted = Color3.fromRGB(148, 167, 181),
        accent = Color3.fromRGB(136, 211, 237), good = Color3.fromRGB(137, 218, 175),
        bad = Color3.fromRGB(237, 149, 149), line = Color3.fromRGB(60, 76, 91)
    }
}

-- BEGIN CATALOG LOGIC (also exercised by the offline validation harness)
function M.nonempty(value)
    return type(value) == "string" and value ~= ""
end

function M.icon(value)
    if type(value) == "number" or (type(value) == "string" and value:match("^%d+$")) then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(value)
    end
    return type(value) == "string" and value or ""
end

function M.key(value)
    return tostring(value):gsub("%s+", "-"):upper()
end

function M.configPath(root, path)
    local node = root
    for segment in tostring(path):gmatch("[^/]+") do
        if type(node) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local nextNode = node[segment]
        if nextNode == nil then
            for key, value in pairs(node) do
                if type(key) == "string" and M.key(key) == M.key(segment) then
                    nextNode = value
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if nextNode == nil then return nil end
        node = nextNode
    end
    return node
end

function M.findConfig(packages, defaultPackage)
    if type(packages) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local roots, seen = {}, {}
    local function add(name, value)
        if type(value) == "table" and not seen[value] then
            seen[value] = true
            roots[#roots + 1] = {name = name, value = value}
        end
    end
    add("brookhaven", packages.brookhaven)
    for key, value in pairs(packages) do
        if type(key) == "string" and key:lower() == "brookhaven" then add(key, value) end
    end
    if type(defaultPackage) == "string" then add(defaultPackage, packages[defaultPackage]) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(packages) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do add(tostring(key), packages[key]) end
    add("root", packages)
    for _, candidate in ipairs(roots) do
        local config = M.configPath(candidate.value, "Tools/Config")
        if type(config) == "table" then return config, candidate.name end
    end
    return nil
end

function M.filterText(value)
    if type(value) == "string" then return value end
    local out = {}
    if type(value) == "table" then
        for key, item in pairs(value) do
            if type(item) == "string" then out[#out + 1] = item
            elseif item == true and type(key) == "string" then out[#out + 1] = key end
        end
    end
    table.sort(out)
    return table.concat(out, ", ")
end

function M.parseConfig(config, source)
    local entries, categories, stats = {}, {}, {rows = 0, tools = 0, categories = 0, skipped = 0, duplicates = 0}
    if type(config) ~= "table" then return entries, categories, stats end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(config) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
        local raw = config[key]
        stats.rows = stats.rows + 1
        if type(raw) == "table" then
            local name = M.nonempty(raw.Name) and raw.Name or (type(key) == "string" and key or nil)
            if name and name ~= "" and name ~= "ClearTools" then
                if entries[name] then
                    stats.duplicates = stats.duplicates + 1
                else
                    local isCategory = raw.IsCategory == true
                    local gun = M.nonempty(raw.GunSkin) and raw.GunSkin or nil
                    local item = M.nonempty(raw.Item) and raw.Item or nil
                    local requirement = raw.RequirementBehaviorData
                    local e = {
                        name = name, displayName = M.nonempty(raw.DisplayName) and raw.DisplayName or name,
                        category = M.nonempty(raw.Category) and raw.Category or "",
                        icon = M.icon(raw.Icon or raw.IconWhenUnlocked),
                        order = tonumber(raw.Order) or 0, isCategory = isCategory,
                        kind = isCategory and "Category" or (gun and "Gun skin" or "Tool"),
                        route = not isCategory and (gun and "GunEquip" or "PickingTools") or nil,
                        gunSkin = gun, item = item, filters = M.filterText(raw.Filter),
                        requirement = type(requirement) == "table" and tostring(requirement.Behavior or "Configured") or "",
                        hiddenUnlessUnlocked = raw.HiddenUnlessUnlocked == true,
                        source = source, raw = raw, catalog = true
                    }
                    entries[name] = e
                    if isCategory then
                        categories[name] = e
                        stats.categories = stats.categories + 1
                    else stats.tools = stats.tools + 1 end
                end
            else stats.skipped = stats.skipped + 1 end
        else stats.skipped = stats.skipped + 1 end
    end
    return entries, categories, stats
end

function M.categoryPath(entry, categories)
    local parts, seen, current = {}, {}, entry.category
    while current and current ~= "" and not seen[current] do
        seen[current] = true
        table.insert(parts, 1, categories[current] and categories[current].displayName or current)
        current = categories[current] and categories[current].category or nil
    end
    return #parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, " / ") or "General"
end

function M.inCategory(entry, wanted, categories)
    if wanted == "" then return true end
    local seen, current = {}, entry.category
    if entry.isCategory and entry.name == wanted then return true end
    while current and current ~= "" and not seen[current] do
        if current == wanted then return true end
        seen[current] = true
        current = categories[current] and categories[current].category or nil
    end
    return false
end

function M.matches(entry, query)
    local haystack = table.concat({entry.name, entry.displayName, entry.kind, entry.category,
        entry.categoryPath or "", entry.filters or "", entry.item or "", entry.source or ""}, " "):lower()
    for word in query:lower():gmatch("%S+") do
        if not haystack:find(word, 1, true) then return false end
    end
    return true
end

function M.requestArgs(entry)
    if entry.isCategory then return nil end
    if entry.route == "GunEquip" and M.nonempty(entry.gunSkin) then
        return "Remotes.GunEquip", {entry.gunSkin, entry.name}
    end
    if entry.route == "PickingTools" then
        return "RE.1Too1l", {"PickingTools", entry.name}
    end
    return nil
end

function M.actionDecision(entry, intent, present, busy)
    if entry.isCategory then return "category" end
    if intent == "hold" and present then return "hold" end
    if intent == "get" and present then return "owned" end
    if intent == "remove" and not present then return "absent" end
    if busy then return "busy" end
    if M.requestArgs(entry) then return "request" end
    if (intent == "get" or intent == "hold") and entry.interactions and #entry.interactions > 0 then return "interaction" end
    return "unavailable"
end
-- END CATALOG LOGIC

M.Players = game:GetService("Players")
M.RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
M.Input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
M.Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
M.Tags = game:GetService("CollectionService")
M.Player = M.Players.LocalPlayer
if not M.Player then error("Tool Miner must run on the client.") end
M.PlayerGui = M.Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 15)
if not M.PlayerGui then error("Tool Miner: PlayerGui was not available.") end
M.env = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
if type(M.env.ToolMinerSpawnerUnload) == "function" then pcall(M.env.ToolMinerSpawnerUnload) end
M.started = os.clock()

function M.track(connection, list)
    local target = list or M.connections
    target[#target + 1] = connection
    return connection
end

function M.disconnect(list)
    for _, connection in ipairs(list) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(list)
end

function M.trace(message)
    if M.dead then return end
    local line = string.format("[%6.2fs] %s", os.clock() - M.started, tostring(message))
    M.logs[#M.logs + 1] = line
    if #M.logs > 220 then table.remove(M.logs, 1) end
    print("[ToolMiner] " .. line)
    if M.modalMode == "log" and M.ui and M.ui.exportBox then
        pcall(function() M.ui.exportBox.Text = table.concat(M.logs, "\n") end)
    end
end

function M.status(message, state)
    if M.dead or not M.ui or not M.ui.status then return end
    pcall(function()
        M.ui.status.Text = message
        M.ui.status.TextColor3 = state == true and M.colors.good or (state == false and M.colors.bad or M.colors.muted)
    end)
end

-- task.spawn directly preserves the executor/script capability context more reliably than
-- spawning a manually-created coroutine on some Roblox runtimes.
function M.spawn(callback)
    if M.dead then return end
    local thread
    thread = task.spawn(function()
        local ok, err = xpcall(callback, debug.traceback)
        M.workers[coroutine.running()] = nil
        if not ok and not M.dead then
            M.trace(err)
            M.status("An error occurred. Open Log for details.", false)
        end
    end)
    M.workers[thread] = true
    return thread
end

function M.resolve(root, path)
    local node = root
    for segment in path:gmatch("[^%.]+") do
        node = node and node:FindFirstChild(segment)
        if not node then return nil end
    end
    return node
end

M.confidenceRank = {Candidate = 1, Strong = 2, Confirmed = 3}
M.noisyNames = {
    ["tool"] = true, ["tools"] = true, ["toolscript"] = true, ["toolgiver"] = true,
    ["toolgiverclickpart"] = true, ["handle"] = true, ["template"] = true,
    ["clear tools"] = true, ["cleartools"] = true, ["item"] = true, ["items"] = true,
    ["button"] = true, ["icon"] = true, ["frame"] = true, ["model"] = true
}

function M.cleanCandidateName(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then return nil end
    value = value:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if value == "" or #value > 120 then return nil end
    if M.noisyNames[value:lower()] then return nil end
    if value:match("^rbxassetid://") or value:match("^https?://") then return nil end
    return value
end

function M.addPath(entry, path)
    if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then return end
    entry.observedPaths = entry.observedPaths or {}
    if #entry.observedPaths < 12 and not table.find(entry.observedPaths, path) then
        entry.observedPaths[#entry.observedPaths + 1] = path
    end
end

function M.addSource(entry, source)
    if type(source) ~= "string" or source == "" then return end
    entry.sources = entry.sources or {}
    if #entry.sources < 12 and not table.find(entry.sources, source) then
        entry.sources[#entry.sources + 1] = source
    end
    entry.source = table.concat(entry.sources, " + ")
end

function M.discover(name, options)
    name = M.cleanCandidateName(name)
    if not name then return nil end
    options = options or {}
    local entry = M.observed[name]
    if not entry then
        entry = {
            name = name, displayName = options.displayName or name, category = options.category or "",
            kind = options.kind or "Deep discovery", icon = M.icon(options.icon), order = options.order or 1000000,
            source = "", sources = {}, catalog = false, filters = options.filters or "",
            observedPaths = {}, interactions = {}, observedCount = 0, confidence = options.confidence or "Candidate",
            route = options.route or "PickingTools", gunSkin = options.gunSkin, routeHint = options.routeHint,
            evidence = options.evidence
        }
        M.observed[name] = entry
    end
    entry.observedCount = (entry.observedCount or 0) + 1
    if options.displayName and (entry.displayName == entry.name or entry.displayName == "") then entry.displayName = options.displayName end
    if options.icon and (not entry.icon or entry.icon == "") then entry.icon = M.icon(options.icon) end
    if options.kind and (entry.kind == "Deep discovery" or options.confidence == "Confirmed") then entry.kind = options.kind end
    if options.route then entry.route = options.route end
    if options.gunSkin and not entry.gunSkin then entry.gunSkin = options.gunSkin end
    if options.routeHint and not entry.routeHint then entry.routeHint = options.routeHint end
    if options.evidence and not entry.evidence then entry.evidence = options.evidence end
    local currentRank = M.confidenceRank[entry.confidence] or 0
    local nextRank = M.confidenceRank[options.confidence] or 0
    if nextRank > currentRank then entry.confidence = options.confidence end
    M.addSource(entry, options.source or "Deep discovery")
    M.addPath(entry, options.path)
    if options.interaction then
        entry.interactions = entry.interactions or {}
        if #entry.interactions < 8 and not table.find(entry.interactions, options.interaction) then entry.interactions[#entry.interactions + 1] = options.interaction end
    end
    return entry
end
